category: Nordic cloud drive, subscription, storage-VPS economics in disguise

free_tier.stated: Unlimited storage; 1 user. Free 5 GB tier exists.

egress.terms: No egress fee and no download throttle. Vendor text: 'Reduced upload speed means that uploading files from your device to Jottacloud might take a little longer. Download speed and other use of the service is not changed, and you can still store as much data as you need in your account.' Upload is throttled once >5 TB stored: 'If you store more than 5 TB of data on Jottacloud, your upload speed is automatically reduced. The reduction in upload speed is greater the more data you store in your account.'

interface_detail: Web + desktop + rclone (native `jottacloud` backend, documented on rclone.org)
tooling: rclone native backend, supports --fast-list; CLI documented
chaining: rclone -> local -> any S3/WebDAV target; can front with Cloudflare only by proxying your own origin, not directly
limits_note: Constraint type: per-ip-shaping, upload side only. Reported throttle at 6 TB is ~1.85 MB/s per transfer; at 44 TB one Duplicati user measured 250 KB/s. Download path unaffected. Non-commercial licensing on the Personal tier.
reliability_note: No documented mass data-loss event. Throttle policy was changed retroactively in 2021/2022 and the Norwegian Consumer Council flagged it; users were offered refunds. Operational risk is policy drift, not deletion.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Unlimited* NOK 129 / month NOK 1290 / year ... Unlimited storage ... * Upload speed gradually reduced after 5 TB'
'Download speed and other use of the service is not changed'
44 TB account throttled to 250 KB/s upload, download fine
payment: 'We support VISA and MasterCard' via Stripe; no PayPal, no crypto

price_per_tb_month: $2.76/TB at 5 TB; $0.69/TB at 20 TB (NOK 129/mo = $13.79 flat, so marginal cost per added TB is $0)
notes: Unlimited storage; 1 user. Free 5 GB tier exists.
